definition.name: NXspm_piezo_config
definition.doc:
A base class describing piezo actuator settings for scanning probe microscopy.
Piezoelectric actuators work utilizing the inverse-piezoelectric effect, when a voltage is applied on the material and it deforms proportional to the applied voltage. Description below shows calibration coefficients and other configuration parameters of open loop piezo actuators (that is actuators without capacitive sensor feedback systems).

field.name: depends_on
field.doc: The frame along whose axes all AXIS quantities of this group are given (e.g. ``rangeAXIS``, ``calibratedAXIS``, ``tiltAXIS``, ``driftAXIS``). Points to an :ref:`NXcoordinate_system` (the :ref:`scanner_frame </NXspm/ENTRY/scanner_frame-group>` in NXspm).

group.name: piezo_material
group.doc: The material description and properties of the piezoelectric scanner materials.

field.name: curvature_radiusAXIS
field.doc: AXIS denotes the ``x`` or ``y`` axis (e.g. ``curvature_radius_x``). It can be set approximately to the length of the piezo tube along the corresponding axis.

field.name: calibration_type
field.doc: The name of the calibration type, sometimes it is called `active calibration`.

field.name: calibration_name
field.doc: A specific name of the calibration (e.g. active type with name 'LHe').

field.name: calibratedAXIS
field.doc: The calibration of the piezo along the AXIS axis of the frame given by ``depends_on``, i.e. the displacement per applied voltage (e.g. Nanonis ``Calib. X (m/V)``). AXIS denotes the ``x``, ``y`` or ``z`` axis (e.g. ``calibrated_x``). The calibration, the range (``rangeAXIS``) and the HV gain (``hv_gainAXIS``) of an axis depend on each other, so that two of them determine the third. The sign of the calibration follows the instrument settings.

field.name: hv_gainAXIS
field.doc: The gain of the high-voltage amplifier that drives the piezo along the AXIS axis (e.g. Nanonis ``HV Gain X``). AXIS denotes the ``x``, ``y`` or ``z`` axis (e.g. ``hv_gain_x``).

field.name: rangeAXIS
field.doc: AXIS denotes the ``x``, ``y`` or ``z`` axis (e.g. ``range_x``). The range is the maximum distance the piezo can move along that axis.

field.name: coefficientAXIS
field.doc: The calibration coefficient is the ratio of the actual distance moved by the piezo due to the voltage or external force applied to the piezo. It is also called first-order correction. AXIS denotes the ``x`` or ``y`` axis (e.g. ``coefficient_x``).

field.name: second_order_correctionAXIS
field.doc: AXIS denotes the ``x`` or ``y`` axis (e.g. ``second_order_correction_x``). If you know them, you can enter the 2nd order piezo characteristics to compensate the error for that axis. The following equation shows the interpretation of the 2nd order correction parameters. For the ``x`` piezo: :math:`U_x = \frac{1}{c_x} \cdot X + c_{xx} \cdot X^2` with units: :math:`[V] = \frac{[V]}{[m]} \cdot [m] + \frac{[V]}{[m^2]} \cdot [m^2]` where :math:`c_x` is the calibration of the ``x`` piezo and :math:`c_{xx}` is the 2nd order correction. The unit for the second-order correction is (:math:`\frac{V}{m^2}`).

field.name: tiltAXIS
field.doc: Tilt correction angle along the AXIS axis of the frame given by ``depends_on``, set in the piezo configuration to compensate the slope of the sample surface (e.g. Nanonis ``Piezo Configuration>Tilt X (deg)``). AXIS denotes the ``x`` or ``y`` axis (e.g. ``tilt_x``). The sign follows the convention of the instrument.

field.name: drift_correction_status
field.doc: The drift correction status (true / false) in calibration step of piezo.

field.name: driftAXIS
field.doc: The drift-compensation speed (a length per time, e.g. m/s) along the AXIS axis of the frame given by ``depends_on``: the piezo is moved at this speed to compensate the thermal drift between tip and sample while ``drift_correction_status`` is true (e.g. Nanonis ``Drift X (m/s)``). AXIS denotes the ``x``, ``y`` or ``z`` axis (e.g. ``drift_x``).
